ITEM 1 | Pale green leafy greens with ruffled, crisp-looking edges and pale yellow-white inner leaves, coated in a creamy, slightly glossy pale dressing; torn into irregular pieces about 3-5 cm, piled on the left-center of the bowl | 85
ITEM 2 | Golden-brown toasted bread cubes with crisp, slightly porous surfaces and darker browned edges, roughly 1.5-2 cm cubes, scattered among the greens on the upper left | 22
ITEM 3 | Pale green melon chunks with smooth, slightly translucent rind-edged skin and pale cream flesh, cut into wedges and cubes about 3-4 cm, moist-looking, holding shape, arranged on the right side and bottom of the bowl | 150
ITEM 4 | Small pale green grapes, smooth and round, about 1.5-2 cm diameter, slightly glossy, two to three grapes clustered near the center-right among the melon | 12
ITEM 5 | Creamy pale dressing, thin white-yellow coating with slight sheen, visible as a light film clinging to the lettuce leaves and dripping into the bowl's lower area | 15
